system.description: A personal code of behavior and ethics, separate from your Path of Enlightenment and shaped by your own experiences, guides your actions. Work with your Storyteller to build it, including prohibitions and hindrances as well as beliefs. You gain one free retest whenever a Mental or Social situation, such as supernatural persuasion or possible frenzy, might cause you to violate your code.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Character Creation and Traits
